entry.text: Project Description
The project focuses on implementing and enhancing IT Asset Management (ITAM) solutions, including Hardware
Asset Management (HAM) and Software Asset Management (SAM), using ServiceNow. The objective is to
automate asset lifecycle processes, improve asset visibility and compliance, and maintain accurate asset data
through normalization and reconciliation. The solution supports end-to-end asset management from
procurement through retirement while integrating with ITSM.
Roles & Responsibilities
• Implemented and enhanced ITAM, HAM, and SAM modules to manage the complete asset lifecycle,
including procurement, inventory, allocation, maintenance, and retirement.
• Configured hardware and software asset models, categories, lifecycle states, and related configurations
based on organizational requirements.
• Worked on SAM processes, including software license tracking, entitlement management, compliance
monitoring, and license reclamation.
• Performed data normalization and reconciliation to maintain accurate and reliable asset and license data.
• Designed and developed Service Catalog items and Record Producers for asset requests, approvals, and
fulfillment.
• Developed and maintained Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and UI Actions to automate asset-
related processes.
• Created reports and dashboards to provide visibility into asset utilization, compliance, and cost
optimization.
• Worked with Import Sets and Transform Maps to import asset data from external systems and vendors.
• Implemented ACLs and role-based access controls to secure asset-related data.
• Participated in ServiceNow upgrade activities, including testing ITAM/SAM functionality and resolving
skipped records.
• Collaborated with business stakeholders, procurement teams, and asset managers to gather
requirements and deliver scalable ITAM solutions.
• Provided production support, troubleshooting, and continuous enhancements to ensure system stability
and user satisfaction.

entry.text: Project Description
The project focused on implementing and enhancing ServiceNow IT Asset Management (ITAM)
capabilities, primarily across Software Asset Management (SAM), Hardware Asset Management (HAM),
and Custom Applications. The solution was designed to automate asset-related processes, improve data
accuracy, streamline software licensing and hardware lifecycle management, and support business-specific
requirements through custom ServiceNow applications.
Roles & Responsibilities
• Worked on SAM and HAM implementations and enhancements based on business requirements.
• Configured and maintained software models, hardware models, asset records, categories, lifecycle
states, and asset-related configurations.
• Worked on software entitlements, license compliance, software consumption, reclamation, and license
tracking.
• Supported hardware asset lifecycle management, including procurement, inventory, assignment,
transfer, maintenance, and retirement.
• Developed and configured Custom Applications to address business-specific asset management
requirements.
• Designed and developed Service Catalog items, Record Producers, Variables, and Variable Sets for
asset-related requests.
• Developed and maintained Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, and Data Policies.
• Designed and configured Inbound and Outbound Email Actions to automate business processes and
notifications.
• Created customized notifications and email templates to improve communication between
stakeholders.
• Worked with Import Sets and Transform Maps to import and transform asset and software data from
external sources.
• Performed data validation, troubleshooting, and reconciliation to maintain accurate asset information.
• Created reports and dashboards to provide visibility into asset utilization, software compliance, and
operational metrics.
• Participated in ServiceNow upgrade activities, including testing functionality and analyzing skipped
records.
• Gathered requirements from business stakeholders and translated them into scalable ServiceNow
solutions.

entry.text: Project Description
The project focused on implementing and customizing ServiceNow IT Asset Management (ITAM)
capabilities, with primary emphasis on Software Asset Management (SAM), Hardware Asset Management
(HAM), and Custom Applications. The solution supported end-to-end asset lifecycle management, software
license compliance, asset data management, and business-specific automation through customized
ServiceNow applications.
Roles & Responsibilities
1. Implemented and enhanced SAM and HAM functionalities, supporting end-to-end software and
hardware asset lifecycle management.
2. Configured software/hardware models, asset categories, lifecycle states, entitlements, license
allocation, compliance, consumption, and reclamation processes.
3. Worked on SAM integrations with Microsoft and Adobe to support software discovery, entitlement,
license consumption, and compliance data.
4. Developed and customized ServiceNow Custom Applications based on business requirements.
5. Designed and developed Service Catalog items, Record Producers, Variables, Variable Sets, and
Workflows for asset-related processes.
6. Developed and maintained Client Scripts, Business Rules, UI Policies, UI Actions, and Data Policies for
business process automation.
7. Worked with Import Sets and Transform Maps to import, transform, and validate hardware, software,
and asset data.
8. Configured ACLs, Users, Groups, and Roles to implement secure, role-based access to asset and
application data.
9. Created Reports and Dashboards to provide visibility into asset utilization, software compliance, and
operational metrics.
10. Participated in ServiceNow upgrade activities, including testing, monitoring, and resolving skipped
records.
11. Used Update Sets to migrate configurations across development and testing environments.
12. Gathered requirements from business stakeholders and translated them into scalable technical
solutions.
13. Provided production support, troubleshooting, and enhancements for SAM, HAM, integrations, and
custom applications.

entry.text: Project Description
The project involved implementing and customizing Incident Management, Problem Management,
Change Management, and Service Catalog capabilities in ServiceNow for Loan Depot. The solution
focused on improving IT service management processes and automating request fulfillment through
customized catalog items and workflows.
Roles & Responsibilities
• Configured and customized Incident, Problem, and Change Management modules based on business
requirements.
• Developed and maintained Service Catalog items, Variables, Variable Sets, and Workflows for different
business requirements.
• Gathered requirements from clients and translated them into technical solutions and catalog
configurations.
• Developed Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Actions, and UI Policies to implement business
requirements.
• Used HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to enhance ServiceNow user interfaces and form experiences.
• Worked with Import Sets, Transform Maps, and data imports to migrate and load data into
ServiceNow.
• Platform Roadmap Ownership: Contributed to the ServiceNow platform roadmap by identifying ITAM,
SAM, HAM, and ITSM enhancement opportunities, prioritizing automation and process improvements
based on business requirements.
• Platform Enhancement Planning: Worked with business and technical stakeholders to define and
prioritize ServiceNow enhancements, including custom applications, Service Catalog workflows,
integrations, and asset lifecycle improvements, ensuring alignment with long-term platform objectives.
• Created and configured SLAs and Email Notifications to support IT service processes.
• Configured Forms, Lists, and related table configurations according to business requirements.
• Created and administered Users, Groups, and Roles.
• Participated in ServiceNow upgrade activities, including monitoring and analyzing skipped records.
• Used Update Sets to migrate configurations from development to testing environments.
• Performed testing and troubleshooting of configurations and customizations to ensure solution quality.
• Collaborated with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver ServiceNow solutions aligned
with business needs.
Micro Certiication:
• ServiceNow Micro-Certification – Flow Designer: Hands-on experience designing automated
workflows, approval processes, and reusable flows for ITAM, HAM, SAM, and ITSM processes.
• ServiceNow Micro-Certification – Performance Analytics: Experience developing dashboards, KPIs,
and operational metrics for asset utilization, software compliance, and IT service performance.
